claims.statement: Strong C4-free, mass, model, criticality and irreducibility conventions; accepted inputs have the used scope.
P3(K) and OIR(K) are equivalent; a counterexample to P3 is irreducible and violates GEN_K.
OE(K) implies P3(K); a regional converse is not claimed.
Triangle-free positive induced-critical graphs satisfy rho <= K-1.
rho <= max(K-1, 2K-epsilon-2).
At epsilon=1, rho <= 2K-4; hence this bound holds for all positive critical graphs, K>=3.
K=3 outer rho>=3 is empty; K=4,5 path-capped analogues follow; K=6 surplus table and surviving ranges are correct.
If positive capped graphs have order >=m, critical capped graphs with n<=m+rho have no positive proper model.
Path-free collar n<=K^2+rho+3 and K=6 path-capped collar n<=rho+42; positive capped quotients need n>=rho+43.
One-region contraction is admissible iff every outside vertex has at most one neighbor in A.
Exact contraction mass loss and positive-surplus budget (23.6)-(23.7); representative costs cannot be added without justification.
Contracting an entire connected dominating set cannot produce a positive admissible quotient for K>=2.
Connected-domination inequality (23.8), gamma_c>=K for positive graphs, and exclusion of a dominating set of size <=K with internal minimum degree >=2.
One-vertex augmentation raises an old-edge transversal by at most one; new-edge bound, regular-augmentation and pentagon-free-base screens.
Every strongly C4-free one-vertex augmentation of the supplied G151 base has rho<=2.
A simple undirected abelian Cayley graph that is strongly C4-free has degree <=2 and no positive K-surplus for K>=3.
The specified host is HS, strongly C4-free, and all 1,000 displayed P13 paths are induced.
The 550-variable, 2,932-clause CNF exactly encodes at most nine deletions and hitting all listed paths.
The supplied RUP-with-deletions refutation is valid and derives the empty clause.
Every HS induced subgraph on at least 41 vertices, hence every positive-6-surplus induced subgraph, contains P13.
Packing and complete cover certificates prove exact all-edge tau and rho.
Excluded-vertex and triangle-branch flows prove full induced criticality.
329 distinct controls cover all stated source families, including 200 HS records, 114 repairs, six triangle controls and named controls.
Fresh long paths, all-edge rho, contact identities, connected dominating sets and applicable rho restrictions pass the supplied controls.
Deleting vertex 6 and using bag {3,42} gives a proper strongly C4-free positive quotient.
Three ER parents, two nonpositive ER7 samples, and twelve positive triangle-free critical cores have the stated parameters and long paths.
The three critical HS cores have (K,n,rho)=(3,17,1),(4,30,2),(5,35,2).
All 500 repair outputs have the reported histogram and P13; exactly 383 triangular outputs have rho>=3 and epsilon=1.
Triangle trial 1 has (K,n,e,T,epsilon,rho)=(6,50,152,1,1,3), is induced-critical, and contains the displayed P13.
The complete stated 464-record size-at-most-three domain contains 5,246 transversals, none satisfying H.
G42 admits no legal single-edge addition; the stated HS triangle-addition/switch scans yield no positive legal output.
The complete connected strongly C4-free catalogue through order eight and all domination/contraction counts are correct.
HS core 2 is an induced-critical, irreducible outer graph with (K,n,rho,epsilon,T,p)=(6,42,3,2,0,20); order 42 is minimum possible.
HS core 7 has a P12 at exact one-vertex-exchange distance three from an extension.
Contracted Heawood, Robertson+1, F121/F91 and G151 retain the long-path and local-obstruction properties cited in the report.
The eight-row partition remains unchanged; rho tails are empty and the surviving model collar has the stated scope.
Near-barrier input + small-transversal input + OIR imply IR and GEN; C+R imply P3; D implies OE implies P3.
P3, OIR, OE, unrestricted IR_K and GEN_K, and closure of rows 4/8.
C(K) and C6+ collar path assertions.
R(K) and its K=6 restricted remainder.
D(K), the proposed small/structured dominating-set alternative.
No requested counterexample was found; no timeout, sampled family or bounded search is used as a general exclusion.
All required artifacts and stated mathematical certificate rules suffice without prover development code.

required_fixes.text: State explicitly that model-exclusion and first-shell conclusions concern positive proper admissible models of positive induced-critical sources; alternatively assume directly that the positive model has a nonsingleton bag. Add these hypotheses to the finite-reduction metadata and matching summary wording.
required_fixes.reason: The representative lower bound n-|J|>=1+rho requires an internal edge. It does not apply to the identity model or to a deletion-only model; induced criticality excludes the latter only for a proper model. Theorem 9 already contains the required qualification, but the subsequent standalone corollary and shell sentence omit it.
